article.title: How many time zones does America need anyway?
article.excerpt: Allison Schrager writes: This year, Americans on Eastern Standard Time should set their clocks back one hour (like normal), Americans on Central and Rocky Mountain time do nothing, and Americans on Pacific time should set their clocks forward one hour.
